Zoe: Heads-up: Monday 11am PT webinar on inference benchmarks. Need final owners for reg page, Zoom settings, recording delivery, and post-event lead routing. Keep it tight.

Cal: I'll handle Zoom + recording handoff. Quick plan: cloud recording (speaker + shared screen), enable audio transcript (VTT), add co-host Renee, record local backup with OBS, RTMP fallback OFF (avoid complexity). Keep 'Only authenticated users' OFF.

Renee: I'll do the reg page + tracking. Required fields: email, company, job_title. Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_content. HubSpot form ID: will paste when staging published. Tag: webinar_bench_0708. Need confirm on calendar invite copy.

Hector: Editing + social. Deliverables: 2x 30s clips (16:9), 1x 60s highlight (16:9), SRT captions, and plain .txt transcript. Preferred filenames: WB0708_raw_cloud.mp4, WB0708_transcript.txt. I need raw access ASAP after event.

Cal: Post-event upload steps: 1) Download cloud MP4 + VTT 2) Grab local OBS MP4 if available 3) Upload to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-07-08-bench/raw/ with ACL marketing-editors 4) Generate 30-day signed replay URL and paste here. I'll aim to upload within 90 minutes.

Renee: Replay email draft (short): "Thanks for joining! Watch the replay and clips here. Key takeaway: 3x cost vs baseline with batching. Book a demo." Thoughts?

Hector: Good. Emphasize metric "3x cost reduction" in the social hooks. Please include timestamps.txt with speaker ranges — speeds editing. Also want uncompressed WAV if available.

Zoe: Owners recap: Reg page & tracking = Renee; Zoom host + upload = Cal; Clips & edits = Hector; Replay copy + cadence = Zoe. Cadence: 1h replay email, 24h clips push, 48h edited recording + blog. Deadline: raw files uploaded within 90 minutes.

Cal: Adding co-host Renee now and verifying transcript settings. I'll post the S3 link here after upload.

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Cal at 11:01 AM PT.
